data.name: लखन
data.gender_notes: लखन is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, लखन refers to Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe. His name symbolizes the bestower of prosperity, good fortune, and abundance. He is also known as 'Laxmi-Narayan' – the god of wealth with his consort Lakshmi. The name लखन carries the meaning “Giver of Fortune” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose लखन usually hope their child will grow to embody giver of fortune and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the virtues of generosity and abundance.
data.etymology: लखन belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Giver of Fortune.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of लखन total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_sanskrit.name: लक्षण
in_sanskrit.meaning: लक्षणम् कृत्त्वा लक्षयितुम् - to mark, indicate, signify
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who marks, indicates, presence of something, or signifies it. The one who measures, counts, calculates, determines, or discerns. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is also known as Lakshana Murthi, as He is the one who marks or identifies the beginning and end of creation.

data.cultural_impact: The name लखन carries a profound cultural significance, especially in Hindu tradition. It is the name of an avatar, or a manifested form, of Lord Vishnu, one of the primary deities and preservers in Hinduism. According to religious texts, Lord Vishnu embodies the qualities of compassion, love, and goodness. As an avatar, he comes to save humanity from sufferings and negative influences, thereby upholding the balance of the universe. Thus, the name Lakhan is strongly linked with values of salvation, prosperity, and protection within the Hindu culture.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name लखन represents the embodiment of the divine and the eternal. It underscores the idea that the divine is all-present and manifest in myriad forms. For Hindus, Lord Vishnu serves as the representation of the supreme consciousness that underlies the cosmos. The name's spiritual significance lies in its connection to the eternal and almighty power of creation, preservation, and destruction. Devotion to Lord Vishnu through prayer, meditation, and selfless actions is believed to bring about emotional, intellectual, and spiritual growth. Ultimately, the name Lakhan serves as a constant reminder of the divine presence and its guiding role in one's life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Lakhan means "one who illuminates or shines like a jade gem." It symbolizes inner radiance and the ability to bring light to dark situations.

modern_usage.modern_context: Although the original context of the name 'लखन' (Laxman) is from Hindu mythology as the younger brother of Lord Rama and a key character in the epic Ramayana, it has gained modern context and is seen on various platforms. In Google Trends, searches for 'Laxman Rekha' have been increasing, referring to the boundary line drawn by Laxman to protect Sita from other men while Lord Rama was away. On Twitter, the name 'Laxman Rekha' is used as a metaphor to represent personal boundaries and the importance of respecting others' privacy and personal space. On Reddit, users often engage in discussions about the significance of Laxman Rekha in Hindu mythology and its relevance to modern-day concepts of personal boundaries and societal norms.
